correctness.rationale: For every finite field of characteristic at least five, the Segre cubic blowup is the smooth stable six-pointed genus-zero curve compactification. The 15 plane classes and total exceptional class span the rational rank-16 Picard group, verified directly from all Keel relations. Frobenius traces on its even cohomology are 1+Fix(M), and correcting the ten exceptional quadrics by their rulings removes Fix(N) q² + Fix(R) q. The proof explicitly distinguishes split and nonsplit quadrics, derives extension-field and zeta formulas, and covers all eleven conjugacy types by exact enumeration. The independent F5 trace-equation enumeration checks all eleven first-field counts. No finite test is substituted for the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Classifying every arithmetic form of this canonical ten-nodal cubic by point-count polynomials and rational zeta factors answers a natural exact arithmetic invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice. All eleven S6-conjugacy types are included. The nontrivial action on 20 exceptional-quadric rulings corrects a misleading simplification based on the ten node orbits alone. The full extension-field formulas and independently verified q5 census make the classification reusable.
